description: A live dashboard of all your deadlines — add named countdowns that tick every second, saved in your browser.

faqs.a: In this browser's localStorage. They persist between visits but don't sync across devices.
Yes — every card shows live days, hours, minutes and seconds, updating every second.
Expired deadlines stay on the board marked as passed so you can review or delete them.

howto: Enter a name and date/time for a deadline.
Press Add — a live countdown card appears.
Watch all your deadlines tick in one dashboard.
title: Deadline Countdown Dashboard
